name: Aetheris
description: Aetheris are humanoids who possess radiant auras and glowing eyes. They are the descendants of celestials from the Hallows Above.

features.name: Hallowed Aura
features.description: Once per rest, when an ally within Close range rolls with Fear, you can make it a roll with Hope instead.

features.name: Divine Countenance
features.description: You have advantage on rolls to command or persuade.
